raw_text: The binding constraint shifting from dollar cost to plan rate limit revived a previously demoted optimization: fusing the independent logos operators into a single call. The eight logos dimensions read only raw_text and are independent of each other, so they can be combined into one request that applies every rubric and returns one structured output, sending the long legal raw_text once instead of eight times, while conflict remains a separate second call because it reads the logos output. This was framed as roughly a 4.5x throughput gain entirely in-plan, with the conceptual model preserved because each operator's rubric stays a distinct lens co-resident in one prompt — only the transport collapses, not the operators.
